name: Quantum and Post-Quantum Cryptography
description: Quantum computing basics, quantum cryptography fundamentals, introduction to lattices, learning with errors (LWE), short integer solution (SIS) problem, basic lattice-based cryptographic primitives, security analysis techniques, worst-case to average-case reductions, quantum attacks on lattice problems, quantum attacks on symmetric key primitives, proofs of quantumness, blind delegation, classical verification of quantum computation, unclonable cryptographic primitives.
